scope: Development OOV mechanism ablation, not semantic accuracy
word: lowercase, (?u)\b\w\w+\b tokens, unigram+bigram, raw counts, original corpus smooth IDF and L2
extension: Union vocabulary includes all frozen candidates, queries and controls including interventions; keep original corpus N and df, new terms df=0; explicit transductive diagnostic, no held-out claim
character: lowercase then collapse whitespace; exact character 3,4,5-gram counts including spaces across word boundaries, L2; no hashing, learned vocabulary or IDF; NOT isolated vocabulary ablation
metrics: full-vector equality and cosine for revised/intervention pairs
six fixed-query top1 and all scores
budget: same 3 candidates, 6 queries, top1 positive score, ties by id; not same computational feature budget
checks: frozen_word all rankings and scores equal prior run
stop: Complete all three methods twice; no query rewrite or feature-range tuning; retain adverse control outcomes
